text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day before the end of summer
camp, and
I've just finished seeing off an
exhausted Sakura
Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Fire up the engines I've never used
before, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Those are fine words to declare. I've
changed my
mind on her.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, C.B.! Wait, could it be?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Was it you who cajoled my adorable
Chiyo into
confronting me like that?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh, wow! Just look at how beautiful
the moon
is.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You're awful at deflecting
suspicion!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And yet somehow I know you will still
forgive me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You know, the moon and stars in the sky
can only
follow their inexorable paths
forward. But
wouldn't it be miraculous if
they could alter that
fate?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If the hands of the clock could tick
backwards,
and just for a moment, the
past could change
places with the
future.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If the Derby you left behind and the
Arima Kinen
you never ran were to
manifest before my eyes in
all their
glory...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what the sight of such miracles
might stir
in me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...You sure are selfish, you know that?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, I never pretended to be some
chivalrous
legend.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm just someone who wants to see what
she wants
to see, and who gets lonely
when she loses
someone... Is that so
selfish?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...You two sure know how to stir up
trouble.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But you and Chiyo both understand,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The fact that I've been invited to the
Dream
Trophy means that it's not just me
who knows it...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
They can all see that I've long since
passed my
peak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then, dawn breaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With summer camp behind them, the
Umamusume
are eager to greet the fall
season that lies
ahead...
